messages: Joanne: quick check — the toolbar CTA weights look off on the dashboard header. primary feels too heavy next to ghost CTA, especially at 320px width. attaching screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/u/toolbar-cta.png Eli: +1 seeing it. primary appears bolder because of the stroke contrast rather than weight. can we try reducing primary font-weight from 600 -> 550? Kevin: 550 is a weird weight for system fonts. maybe instead reduce padding on primary so optical weight reads smaller? Joanne: good call. my concern is different: VoiceOver reads the toast immediately after a CTA click and the toast copies are long — it interrupts the flow. we should make toasts aria-friendly and ensure a polite announcement. Design Bot: accessibility-scan: toast role="status" is currently used (assertive). recommended: change to role="status" with aria-live="polite" to avoid interrupting screen readers. Contrast: .btn-ghost text on surface is 3.9:1 — passing AA but marginal for small text. Samir: for the CTA visual imbalance, propose 3 changes to test A/B: 1) reduce primary horizontal padding 2) lower font-weight to 600->500 fallback 3) tweak ghost border alpha + token tweak. Eli: for toasts I'd rather keep them assertive for error-level toasts only. info/success should be polite. so aria-live mapping by intent. Joanne: agreed. acceptance criteria: "error toasts announce assertive, others polite" + "toolbar primary should not exceed optical weight of adjacent ghost button at 320px" + "toast copy readout trimmed to ~120 chars for screen readers" Kevin: small CSS snippet to try (feel free to copy into experiment branch): ``` :root { --btn-primary-padding-x: 12px; /* was 16 */ --btn-primary-font-weight: 600; /* experiment with 500 fallback */ --toast-announce-length: 120ch; /* runtime trim for VO */ } ``` Eli: also add an aria-hidden trim for long metadata in the toast: (details) and then provide a link to the full message if needed. Samir: can we also tighten vertical spacing token for toast stack? current token `space-toast-vertical: 16` feels large; try 10 for mobile. Design Bot: visual-regression: when primary padding lowered, header layout shift detected on mobile by 2px (within tolerance). Joanne: great. plan: @Eli to prototype CSS changes in /design/cta-voiceover-experiment branch, @Kevin to implement aria-live changes & trim logic, @Samir to run a quick visual A/B on mobile widths. I'll schedule a 15m sync tomorrow to review results. Eli: started branch, pushed minimal changes: https://git.redwood.dev/commit/fea123. left notes in PR about fallback font weight quirks. Kevin: PR for aria changes up: https://git.redwood.dev/commit/bbf456. includes tests for `role` + `aria-live` per intent. Samir: ran quick mobile scout — reduced padding + weight tweak looks cleaner. toast vertical spacing at 10px = tighter and less distracting. attaching gif: https://img.redwood.dev/u/toast-stack-compact.gif Joanne: awesome. acceptance tests for QA: 1) VoiceOver reads error immediately, info polite 2) toolbar scan at 320px shows no perceived overweighting 3) toast copy trimmed for VO 4) ghost button contrast rechecked at small text. Eli: I'll add the QA checklist to the PR. Design Bot: reminder: update tokens.md and changelog: `space-toast-vertical` and `--btn-primary-padding-x` changed. Joanne: thanks all. if no blockers I'll merge tomorrow after the sync. :+1:
